summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K with Item 3.02 and 8.01 on June 26, 2026, disclosing it filed a prospectus supplement covering the resale of 3,378,084 shares by certain stockholders. The shares were previously issued as consideration in two acquisitions: 3,285,696 from the May 21, 2026 acquisition of Omnisys Ltd. and 92,388 from the April 1, 2026 acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. The filing is a routine resale registration, not a new special situation event. The issuer, Ondas, is acting as filer. No price, premium, or recommendation is stated; the filing merely covers the mechanics of registering existing shares.
